source: Arapahoe Basin trail report (resort feed, mtnpowder.com resortId 93)
note: Steep Gully 1-5 and 1st-8th Tree Chute are the resort's grouped entries 'SG 1'..'SG 5' and 'Tree Chutes 1-8' (both double black in the feed) under the names the map uses.

not_runs.Tree Chutes 1-8: one report line for the eight East Wall tree chutes, listed on the map as 1st to 8th Tree Chute
not_runs.Steep Gullies Hike Back Trail: the walking route back from the bottom of the Steep Gullies to the area, not a ski run
not_runs.Pika Place: beginner area served by the Pika Place carpet, not a separate run line

note_not_same: 'The Humbugs' (double-black East Wall chutes in OpenStreetMap) is not the resort's blue 'Humbug' on the front side, which is a separate run on the map.
